facts.fact: The African Union announced on 9 October 2026 that the 6th Ordinary Session of its Specialised Technical Committee on Communication and ICT will be held in Libreville, Gabon, on 26-29 October 2026 (a forward notice; the meeting had not yet taken place), with ministers of AU member states attending; no date is given for the event announcement, so the published date is used.
